explication: Kubernetes Dashboard is a web UI for managing and troubleshooting Kubernetes workloads and cluster resources. Users enter through the authenticated browser chrome, navigate resource views or tools, and inspect or act on cluster objects; custom-resource views also expose raw YAML/JSON. The repository separates the UI, Kubernetes API, authentication, and metrics scraper into modules. The README documents Kong as the gateway connecting these containers. Source evidence is strongest for UI routing and CRD detail behavior; backend links and several feature implementations are inferred only at subsystem level.
